facts.fact: SEGIB reports a triangular cooperation project (Portugal, Argentina, the Autonomous Government of Principe) has started for Principe island, with digital classrooms in schools and adult training centres as two of four identified projects; Principe only, not stated as delivered.
facts.system: Triangular Cooperation project for Principe digitalisation

systems.system: Triangular Cooperation project for Principe digitalisation
systems.owner: Autonomous Government of Principe with Portugal (Camoes), Argentina (IPDAL, PAD), SEGIB

STP.note: No office connection of any local government is stated; the project covers Principe's digitalisation in general.
A study on digitising municipal tourism fee collection is still in progress; no revenue system or pilot is stated.
